messages.subject: GCC Executive Profile | Country Leadership, Government Relations, ESG & Strategic Partnerships
messages.body:
Dear Madison Pearl Executive Search Team,

I am sharing my profile for senior and confidential mandates across the UAE, Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC. Madison Pearl's Dubai base, regional executive-search platform and work with senior leaders across major financial and sovereign-linked institutions make this a relevant introduction.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and sustainability, external and corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, social performance and executive advisory within a major gold-mining operation.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head, Country Director or Representative, Executive Director and VP-track appointments. My strongest fit is where country leadership intersects with government relations, ESG, strategic partnerships, infrastructure, natural resources, energy transition and complex regulated operations.

I am internationally mobile, open to expatriate and residential assignments, and available on 30 days' notice. My GCC-focused executive CV is attached for consideration across suitable current or confidential searches.

Preferred reply address: ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
